New highlighting behaviour in `ReprHighlighter` is a feature request, and per the [feature template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md), new features need to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened. Please start a discussion there if you want to pursue it.

Meanwhile, you can style units with a custom highlighter. The [highlighting docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst) show how to subclass `RegexHighlighter`.

Related: #3318 covers separators and binary forms in the number regex.
